result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon, which breaks the visual consistency of the navigation.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation shows only the text label and no icon, while the Home, Search, and Profile tabs display both an icon and a label.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended icon above the 'Orders' label to match the rest of the bottom navigation items.
